svg.title: Issue 3 — Page 4 — Panel 4: CUT — squad camp inside wall void
svg.desc: Wide 35mm slight high angle. LOCATION SHIFT: hidden camp inside Victorian wall void, between rough timber beams + brick wall, cobwebs in corners. Small power cell on floor casts blue-white structured light. Four 4-inch figures: Sable (silver, cracked shoulder) arms crossed at gap looking out; Wren (copper, oil-stained, hair bun) at salvage bench; Thresh (crimson dented pauldron) seated w/rifle; Luma (sapphire-violet, cracked lens, sapphire filament braid) with holographic data readout. Cool blue-white dominates. Sliver of warm amber gaslight leaks through gap. Parallel solitudes.
